title: MAMath-Bench: Process-Aware and Robust Evaluation of Multimodal Multi-Agent Mathematical Reasoning
abstract: arXiv:2610.26943v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Mathematical reasoning is a fundamental capability for educational applications of Large Language Models (LLMs), where reliable problem solving requires not only correct answers but also coherent and verifiable reasoning processes. Multi-agent systems (MASs) have shown growing potential in this domain by leveraging collaboration and verification among multiple LLM agents. However, existing evaluations primarily focus on the correctness of final answers in text-only settings, offering limited insight into multimodal reasoning capabilities, the reliability of intermediate reasoning steps, and robustness against reasoning errors. To address these limitations, we introduce MAMath-Bench, a process-aware benchmark designed to evaluate the multimodal mathematical reasoning capabilities of MASs. translated_title: MAMath-Bench：面向多模态多智能体数学推理的过程感知与鲁棒性评估
translated_abstract: 数学推理是大语言模型（LLM）教育应用中的一项基础能力，可靠的问题求解不仅需要正确的答案，还需要连贯且可验证的推理过程。多智能体系统（MAS）通过利用多个LLM智能体之间的协作与验证，在这一领域展现出日益增长的潜力。然而，现有评估主要关注纯文本环境下最终答案的正确性，对多模态推理能力、中间推理步骤的可靠性以及对推理错误的鲁棒性方面提供的洞见有限。为解决这些局限，我们提出了MAMath-Bench，这是一个过程感知的基准，旨在评估多智能体系统的多模态数学推理能力。MAMath-Bench包含1,003道题目，涵盖11个数学类别、多个难度级别以及多种模态，包括文本、图像……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出了MAMath-Bench——一个包含1,003道题目、覆盖11个数学类别和多种模态的过程感知基准，首次将多智能体系统的多模态数学推理评估从仅关注最终答案正确性扩展到中间推理步骤的可靠性与对推理错误的鲁棒性。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces MAMath-Bench, a process-aware benchmark of 1,003 multimodal problems that extends the evaluation of multi-agent mathematical reasoning beyond final-answer correctness to the reliability of intermediate reasoning steps and robustness against reasoning errors.
